text: dsh-pr-board 是 DSH Web 的维护者 PR 与 Issue 看板：在侧栏显示计数，并把 PR 分为待我处理、待作者、可合并、已合并和待分诊。它轮询 GitHub、提醒 PR 回到我手上、筛选收件箱，并可将 PR 打开为 DSH review 会话。宿主机需安装并登录 GitHub CLI gh。

dsh-pr-board is a DSH Web maintainer board for GitHub PRs and issues. It groups PRs by who should act next, shows counts, and alerts when a PR returns to you. Inbox filters narrow results by draft, author, or title. Cards can open a DSH review session. The host needs authenticated gh CLI.

dsh-pr-board 的功能「PR 状态看板」：按维护者与作者最近的 review、评论和提交，以及合并状态，把 PR 分类到待我处理、待作者、可合并、已合并或收件箱。。通过看板交互触发，展示对应队列或打开相关会话。
dsh-pr-board 的功能「Issue 支持队列」：根据报告者最近回复、维护者评论、指派或提及状态，把 Issue 分为待我处理、待报告者和最近关闭。。通过看板交互触发，展示对应队列或打开相关会话。
dsh-pr-board 的功能「回到我手上的提醒」：轮询结果出现新的待我处理 PR 时显示提示消息，并让侧栏看板短暂闪动。。通过看板交互触发，展示对应队列或打开相关会话。
dsh-pr-board 的功能「收件箱筛选」：在收件箱按草稿状态、作者登录名片段或标题/编号关键词筛选已载入的 PR，并更新显示计数。。通过看板交互触发，展示对应队列或打开相关会话。
dsh-pr-board 的功能「PR review 会话跳转」：点击 PR 后可按配置的 workspace 查找或新建 DSH review 会话；未配置时可转到 GitHub。。通过看板交互触发，展示对应队列或打开相关会话。

It answers one question: **which PRs need me, right now?**

一个为 DeepSeek Harness 做的**维护者 PR 看板**：回答一个问题——**现在哪些 PR 在等我？**

dsh-pr-board README · dsh-pr-board： *The same example data in the sidebar: one PR row and one indented issue row per repository (me / author / ready / inbox, then me / reporter), plus a `mine` row for PRs you authored. · 同一套示例数据在侧边栏里的样子：每个仓库一行 PR 计数 + 一行缩进的 issue 计数（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 待分诊，然后是等我 / 等报告者），外加一行 `mine` 表示你自己提的 PR。* ---

dsh-pr-board README · Why / 解决什么问题：Reviewing PRs is a queue-management problem. GitHub's native views don't tell you:
"the author just pushed a fix after my change request — it's back on your plate".
This board classifies every PR you're involved in into five states and **detects the
moment a PR moves back to you**.

Review PR 本质是队列管理。GitHub 原生界面无法直接告诉你"作者刚在你 request changes
之后推了新提交，又该你出手了"。本插件把你参与的每个 PR 归入五种状态，并**在 PR
回到你手上的一刻提醒你**。

dsh-pr-board README · The five states / 五种状态：| Column / 列 | Meaning / 含义 | How it's decided / 判定依据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Waiting on me** 等我行动 | Your move / 该你出手 | Review requested with no substantive word from you yet; or the author pushed/replied after your last action; or new commits landed after your approval. Your own substantive comment holds the ball with the author — emoji-only / "+1"-style comments don't count on either side |
| **Waiting on author** 等作者行动 | Their move / 等作者 | You (or another maintainer) requested changes and the author has been quiet since; approved but draft or conflicting |
| **Ready to merge** 可合并 | Green light / 绿灯 | `reviewDecision = APPROVED`, mergeable, not draft — or in a merge queue, or auto-merge armed with nothing blocking (blocked auto-merge waits on the author) |
| **Merged** 已合并 | Done / 完成 | Recently merged PRs you reviewed |
| **Inbox** 新 PR 待分诊 | New & unclaimed | Newest open PRs you haven't touched — one click ("我来 review") adds you as reviewer |
section: The five states / 五种状态

dsh-pr-board README · The five states / 五种状态：Transition detection: when a PR crosses **author → you** (author responded, or
re-requested your review), you get a toast and the sidebar widget pulses.
Status-quo polling keeps the board fresh (interval configurable: 1–30 min).
section: The five states / 五种状态

text:
dsh-pr-board README · Issue board / Issue 看板：Each monitored repo gets a second sidebar row (indented, `iss` tag) with issue
counters; clicking it opens a three-column **issue board**: **Waiting on me**
(the reporter replied after your last comment, or you're assigned/mentioned
with nothing from you yet), **Waiting on reporter** (you hold the last word),
and **Recently closed** (closed within 14 days, regression watch). Third-party
comments don't pull a thread back to you — only the reporter's do. Card clicks
open or start a review conversation exactly like PR cards.

dsh-pr-board README · Issue board / Issue 看板：每个监控仓库在侧边栏多一行缩进的 issue 计数（`iss` 标签），点开是三列 issue
看板：等我行动 / 等报告者 / 最近关闭。只有报告者的回复会把线程拉回
"等我"；第三方评论不会。点卡片同样进入/新建对应会话。

状态迁移检测：当 PR 从"等作者"切到"等你"（作者回复 / 重新 request 你 review）时弹
toast 提醒、侧边栏小部件闪烁；轮询间隔 1–30 分钟可配。

dsh-pr-board README · Requirements / 依赖：- The DSH **host** machine has the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) (`gh`)
  installed and **authenticated** (`gh auth login`). The plugin shells out to `gh`
  for search + GraphQL queries, so it respects your `gh` token scopes and GitHub's
  rate limits. If `gh` is missing or logged out, the board shows a setup hint
  instead of raw errors.
- DSH web profile (GUI). This plugin is a web-profile client plugin.

dsh-pr-board README · Requirements / 依赖：DSH 宿主机上需安装并登录 `gh`；插件通过 `gh` 的 search + GraphQL 查询取数，
速率限制遵循你 gh token 的配额。若 `gh` 缺失或未登录，看板会显示安装/登录
指引而不是原始报错。

dsh-pr-board README · Install / 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:delock/dsh-pr-board
```

(or publish to npm and `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pr-board`)

Then restart the web profile and refresh the page.

dsh-pr-board README · Configure / 配置：1. Click the **PR Board** widget at the bottom of the sidebar (or press
   **Alt+P**). On first open you're prompted to add a repository
   (`owner/name`, e.g. `octocat/hello-world`).
2. **Multiple repositories**: the widget lists every monitored repo with its
   own Me / Author / Ready / Inbox counters. The **+** button in the widget header
   (or on the board's tab bar) adds another repo; hovering a tab in the board
   shows an **×** to stop monitoring it (removal lives inside the board only).
   Repos are identified by short name, falling back to the full `owner/name`
   when two monitored repos share a name.
3. **GitHub username** — set via **Settings**; leave blank to auto-use the
   `gh` login account (one identity across all repos).
4. **Review workspaces** — also in **Settings**, configured per repo with no
   global default: every repo carries an explicit workspace, and repos
   without one open their cards on GitHub. When set, clicking a PR card
   jumps into the matching conversation inside DSH. Sessions are matched
   through a local PR→session binding table first, then by title search

dsh-pr-board README · Configure / 配置：配置跨设备共享：账号级字段（仓库列表、用户名、review workspace、自动
prompt、不活跃天数）同步到 host（`~/.dsh/pr-board.config.json`），每个浏览器
只保留自己的轮询间隔。新设备首次打开即继承配置，改动在每次轮询时收敛。

dsh-pr-board README · How states are computed / 状态如何计算：For every open PR you have reviewed / commented on / been requested on, the host
fetches via GraphQL: `reviewDecision`, `mergeable`, draft flag, last commit time,
and the full review + comment timeline. Then:

- Your last action time vs the author's last activity time → who moved last
- Your approval timestamp vs the last commit timestamp → did new code land after
  your OK
- Other maintainers' change requests count as "waiting on author" too
section: How states are computed / 状态如何计算

text:
dsh-pr-board README · How states are computed / 状态如何计算：对每个你参与过的 open PR，host 端经 GraphQL 取 `reviewDecision`、`mergeable`、
draft 标记、最后提交时间及完整 review/评论时间线，据此计算"双方最后动作"、
"批准后有无新提交"、"其他 maintainer 是否提过修改意见"等，得出最终分类。
section: How states are computed / 状态如何计算

text:
dsh-pr-board README · Inbox filters / Inbox 过滤：The Inbox column carries three triage controls at the right end of its **header
row**, after the "Inbox <n>" label — a **draft** checkbox (uncheck to hide draft
PRs), an **@author** field (login substring, `@` optional) and a **keyword**
field (title substring, or a PR number). Sitting inline means they add no
vertical space and every column's header and first card stay on one line. They
narrow the cards the host already delivered, so typing is instant and costs no
GitHub API calls. The header count switches to **shown/total** while anything is
hidden, and the column shows "no match" instead of an empty inbox when
everything is filtered away. Filters are a per-browser view preference (like the
sort toggle), stored in `localStorage`; they do not sync to the host and do not
change the sidebar counters.

dsh-pr-board README · Inbox filters / Inbox 过滤：Caveat: the host fetches the **newest 100 open PRs** as the inbox candidate
pool (`INBOX_POOL` in `index.js`), so filters refine that pool — they cannot
surface a PR outside it. The search API serves 100 per page, so this pool costs
exactly **one** search request per refresh cycle — the same single request the
old 40-item pool cost — and it needs no GraphQL detail calls.

dsh-pr-board README · Inbox filters / Inbox 过滤：Inbox 列的**列头行**右端、紧跟 "Inbox <n>" 之后有三个分诊控件：**draft** 勾选框
（取消勾选即隐藏 draft PR）、**@author** 输入框（作者登录名子串，可省略 `@`）和
**keyword** 输入框（标题子串，或 PR 编号）。放在同一行意味着它们不占额外竖向
空间，五列的列头与首张卡片始终对齐。它们只过滤 host 已取回的卡片，输入即时生效、
不消耗 GitHub API。有内容被隐藏时列头计数变成 **显示数/总数**；全部被过滤掉时
显示 "no match" 而不是空 inbox。过滤条件属于每个浏览器的显示偏好（和排序开关
一样），存在 `localStorage`，不同步到 host，也不改变侧边栏计数。

dsh-pr-board README · Inbox filters / Inbox 过滤：注意：host 以**最新的 100 个 open PR**（`index.js` 的 `INBOX_POOL`）作为 inbox
候选池，过滤只在这个池子里收窄，无法捞出池外的 PR。搜索 API 每页最多 100 条，
所以这个池子正好**一次** search 请求（和原来 40 条池子一样，不额外多花），
且不需要 GraphQL 详情调用。

dsh-pr-board README · Privacy / 隐私：All queries run locally through your own `gh` CLI. No third-party service, no
telemetry, no data leaves your machine except GitHub API calls.

所有查询经本机 `gh` CLI 完成，无第三方服务、无遥测。
